Is there an option for a crowdfunded VC or PE group? While KickStarter and other crowdfunding movements have helped startups get their businesses running I cannot think of a similar example beyond local investment clubs.

The main hurdle I see happening is compliance and getting around the 100 owner rules surrounding LLC, and SEC registration. I don't have a series 6 or 7, let alone JD or LLM so this may not be accurate. From what I remember if you sell securities to more than 100 people you have increased disclosure and registration implications.

It might be possible for the company to get around these rules by issuing up to 100 groups. If each group was considered a separate corporation or other nonsense they could in turn sell their control up to 100 individuals. To encourage participation the first groups would be offered at a discount with the later groups being offered at a premium.

The next administrative hurdle would be handling such a large number of owners in multiple jurisdictions. Beyond the state regulations there would be a large amount of record keeping and K1's to issue. Thankfully being a CPA has some benefits.

The investment selection process would likely be labor intensive as smaller companies tend to have poorer internal controls and decreased reporting transparency. Still, I like the idea of being a partial owner in a few small businesses, supporting local economies, etc.

When I say PE I do not mean that we should buy up small companies, shred their expenses and payroll for the sake of improving margins. I suppose VC is a more accurate description.

My main concern, aside from regulations is the high exposure to fraudulent activity. Every small business I have worked at or for has had serious deficiencies in their controls.
